races.name: two people edit one wiki page

users.name: Manvith
users.setup: Sign in with username "manvith" and password "deadheat1". Go to /manvith/handbook/wiki/Home and click "Edit Page" so the page editor is open.
users.do: In the editor, add this as a new line at the end of the content: "Lunch is at 1 pm." Then click "Save Page".
users.kept: Go to /manvith/handbook/wiki/Home. The page contains the sentence "Lunch is at 1 pm."
